## setting
**23 run(s)** — rule `swi19-f17-setting` — 10.1038/s41467-019-09287-7  
*Methods, second season*

> We replicated the experiment for 14 out of the original 19 cultivars at IRRI the following year (July-December 2017). ... Additionally, at 49 DAS we collected leaf tissue samples for RNA-seq analysis from two cultivars IR-64 and IR83388-B-B-108-3, for transcriptomic analysis.

**228 run(s)** — rule `swi19-f16-setting` — 10.1038/s41467-019-09287-7  
*Methods, 'Plant growth treatments and phenotypic assays'*

> For our field experiments, 19 rice cultivars (listed in Supplementary Fig. 5) were grown under field conditions at the IRRI at Los Banos, Philippines (July-December 2016). Each cultivar was supplied with either a N-replete dose of 150 kg/ha dose of (NH4)2SO4 or with no N-treatment, 23 days after sowing (DAS). Under each N condition, fields were either W-replete or W-deplete, the latter obtained by draining the field of W and protecting the field from rain

## sampling_selection
**251 run(s)** — rule `unselected-PRJNA510920` — (multiple)  
*cross-study determination over the studies' own design statements*

> Determination, not a quotation: for each study below the sampling criterion is stated in the named evidence row, and in none of them is it the presence of disease. PRJNA306542 drought vs well-watered genotype screen (ev-luo2020-design, ev-ma2016-site). PRJNA609211 tillering/maturity stages and an ncRNA arm at the same facility (ev-xia2020t-site, ev-xia2020m-site). PRJNA746402 a maize MAGIC field trial sampled by genotype (ev-cai21b-site). PRJNA383416 a maize diversity panel sampled by genotype and tissue across three settings (ev-krem-field). PRJNA674915/PRJNA915033 grapevine sampled by rootstock, irrigation and phenological stage (ev-har21e-design). PRJNA726716 rice sampled by light and temperature transfer condition (ev-hashida-field). PRJNA510920 rice sampled by nitrogen and water dose at a fixed 49 DAS (ev-swift2019-f16). PRJDB7234 a paddy sampled bihourly for 24 h on sixteen fixed dates (ev-kashima-site). Sampling was therefore driven by genotype, imposed treatment, phenological stage or clock time. Any pathogen present is incidental to why the sample exists, which is the condition the cryptic co-infection hypothesis requires. Contrast disease-selected cohorts, where a plant was sampled BECAUSE it was symptomatic: those are a strong co-infection test set and an unusable prevalence denominator.

## tissue
**23 run(s)** — rule `swi19-f17-tissue` — 10.1038/s41467-019-09287-7  
*Methods, field sampling*

> For each of the 19 rice cultivars, leaf transcriptomes at 49 DAS were sampled at the vegetative stage from 2 individual rice plants in biological triplicate per condition, 2 h after dawn. Leaf tissue was stored in RNA later solution (Thermo Fisher Scientific) immediately upon sampling.

**228 run(s)** — rule `swi19-f16-tissue` — 10.1038/s41467-019-09287-7
